amended.reason: Fixed three faulty assertions. AC6 treated a missing snapshot at S+33 as proof that a wave was still present; when the 1800-tick run ends before S+33, the later age/removal rows were never observed. The test now checks those rows only when the run actually reached S+31, S+32 and S+33. AC10 searched for slam_charge only within the part of its 90-tick window that the run had reached, so a charge that would legitimately start after the run ended was reported as missing; a charge now fails only when the full 90-tick window was observed and none started. AC11 read 'no hit box and no lunge before move tick 20' as banning hit boxes for the whole move; the joint startup rule bans both during the tell, and a knockdown charge in the manner of punk_charge may have its hit box at or after tick 20. The test now rejects only a hit box whose frame starts before move tick 20, while still requiring the lunge to start at tick 20 or later. No threshold or acceptance criterion was lowered.
